detail.longDescription:
flowkey makes it fun and easy to play your favorite songs on piano – whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced player. All songs and courses are created by professional pianists, with interactive lessons, practice tools, and instant feedback to help you learn piano the way that works for you.

Choose from thousands of beautifully-arranged piano pieces covering all genres, including: Classical, Pop, Film & TV and more. With songs available in four difficulty levels, you’ll always find new pieces to play.

If you’re a beginner, learn piano step by step – with courses on how to read sheet music, navigate the keyboard, and play songs with both hands. flowkey’s beginner piano lessons are easy to follow and are a great way to learn piano fundamentals.

Experienced piano players can sharpen their skills with in-depth tutorials covering scales, chords and improvisation.

All you need to learn piano and play your favorite songs is the flowkey app, your device (phone, tablet or laptop), and an instrument. flowkey works with acoustic pianos, digital pianos, and keyboards.

ALL YOU NEED TO LEARN PIANO & KEYBOARD
flowkey’s interactive learning features make piano practice easy – and give you instant feedback on your playing.

🔁Loop: Choose specific sections to practice, and replay until you’ve perfected them.

👐Select a Hand: Practice the right and left hand notes separately.

🎧Wait Mode: Follows as you play and waits for you to hit the right notes and chords. Works with your device’s microphone – or through Bluetooth/MIDI on digital pianos and keyboards.

👀Video: Watch a professional piano player perform the song, see the next notes highlighted on the keyboard, and see how to place your fingers.

▶️Just Play: Perform the whole piece and Just Play keeps up with the score – even if you miss a few notes.

📄Full Sheet Music View: If you’re using a tablet, turn it to portrait mode and practice reading traditional sheet music.

TRY FLOWKEY FOR FREE
Subscribe to the Yearly plan and the first 7 days are free – so you can explore the full piano song library, discover all courses and lessons, and learn how to use flowkey’s practice tools to master your favorite songs faster. 

Not ready to subscribe? A limited selection of beginner piano lessons and classical songs is available to learn for free. 

CHOOSE THE SUBSCRIPTION THAT SUITS YOU
flowkey Premium ✨
- Includes all learning tools and courses 
- Access to the whole song library – including Classical, Pop, Rock, Film & TV and more.
- Use flowkey on multiple devices

flowkey Classic 🎻
- Includes all learning tools and courses 
- Access to all classical and non-copyrighted songs 
- Use flowkey on multiple devices

flowkey Family 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒
- Includes all learning tools and courses 
- Separate Premium accounts for up to 5 people on multiple devices
- Access to the whole song library of digital sheet music

BILLING OPTIONS
Monthly: Stay flexible with monthly billing. Cancel anytime.

Yearly: Save by subscribing to flowkey for 12 months. Includes a 7-day trial, which can be cancelled up to 24 hours before billing starts.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

PEOPLE LOVE FLOWKEY
With over 10 million people learning with flowkey worldwide, and 155,000+ 5-star reviews from happy pianists, keyboard players and piano teachers, we know flowkey’s fun approach to learning works. Ready to try it for yourself?

WE’RE HERE TO HELP
If you have any questions or feedback, you can reach us via email: support@flowkey.com
Or directly in the app by tapping: Settings -> Support & Feedback.

FLOWKEY FOR TEACHERS
If you’re a piano teacher who’d like to use flowkey in lessons, or to support your students’ at-home practice, get in touch with the ‘flowkey for Teachers’ team at: partner@flowkey.com
